narrative.northStar: A law lexicon, worked as a tool
narrative.overview:
Circulars and the policy manual are set as pages of a legal lexicon. Each reading surface is a *leaf* of uncoated paper on a warm grey desk. A guide-word head names what is in view, a *shoulder* column down the outside carries paragraph and clause numbers, and a solid arrow and the analyst's decision tick hang on the line where the evidence starts. Colour sits inside double-ruled *plates* and small ruled tags, and it always appears next to its word.

Navigation, forms, tables and buttons are the standard web controls an analyst already knows. The lexicon supplies type, palette, density and the shoulder, and nothing else. The interface is dense and quiet. Hierarchy comes from tone (desk, then paper, then raised white), from weight and from the serif/sans split, not from shadow. Light theme only (`color-scheme: light`). There is no dark theme in the build.

The rejected default was a grey console with metric cards and an evidence drawer.
keyCharacteristics: Paper leaves on a desk ground, with square corners and no shadows.
Charis SIL for documents, headwords and guide words. Public Sans for controls and data, with tabular figures.
A shoulder (2.25rem) of paragraph and clause numbers. The arrow and tick sit at the first line of the evidence mark.
Colour appears only in plates, impact tags and notices, and always with a word.
Quote status, machine interpretation and analyst decision are shown as three separate states, each with words and an icon.
Two authored motions, both 180ms `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`: the shoulder arrow and tick travelling to the next quoted line, and the decision tick settling in.

rules.name: The Plate Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Impact colour appears only inside a ruled element: a plate, an impact tag, or a notice. It always sits next to the word it codes. Nothing relies on hue alone.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: No brand accent exists. Ink carries primary actions and ultramarine carries keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Charis is for what is read, Public Sans is for what is operated. Identifiers such as circular numbers stay in a text face, never monospace. They may break only after a slash (`Ident`).

rules.name: The Measure Is a Ceiling Rule
rules.body: `62ch` caps document text but does not set it. In Charis, 62ch comes out at roughly 70 to 72 average characters per line, which is what the full-width memo shows. In the assessment workspace the columns set the line length. At 1440 the leaves run about 49 to 57 characters per line (the text column is about 434px). At 1024 they run about 43 to 50. The two documents sit side by side because that comparison matters more than a longer line.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by stepping desk, paper and raised white. Use box-shadow only to draw rules, with the tooltip as the one exception.

rules.name: The Double Rule Rule
rules.body: Only plates carry the double rule, because a plate is where interpretation and colour live. Notices and tags stay single-ruled, so they never read as a plate.

dos: **Do** put source text in Charis `.doc-text` inside a leaf, with numbers in a 2.25rem shoulder.
**Do** name what a leaf shows with a `GuideHead` (first, title, last) rather than a label above a heading.
**Do** put any interpretation that carries colour inside a double-ruled `Plate`, with the word beside the colour.
**Do** keep quote status, machine interpretation and analyst decision as three separate, labelled states with an icon each.
**Do** label synthetic and fictional material with `SyntheticTag` wherever it appears.
**Do** step tone (desk #E2DED4, paper #FAF8F3, raised #FFFFFF) to separate surfaces.
**Do** keep secondary text in slate soft (#56606E). It holds 4.75:1 on desk and 6.01:1 on paper.
**Do** keep selection and filters in the URL so a refresh or shared link restores them.
donts: **Don't** use slate faint (#7A8391) or rule (#D9D4C8) for text.
**Don't** use impact ink outside a plate, tag or notice, or without its word.
**Don't** add shadows to leaves, plates or panels. Box-shadow draws rules here, and the tooltip is the only floating layer.
**Don't** round leaves, plates, tags or notices.
**Don't** set any text below 12px, or use small caps anywhere except guide words.
**Don't** position the shoulder arrow or tick by measuring layout, and don't animate the arrow.
**Don't** add entrance animations. The arrow's travel and the tick's settle-in are the only authored motions.
**Don't** show a model score as a percentage or a confidence badge, or show an unknown value as zero.
**Don't** ship a dark theme unless every state, contrast pair and chart has been verified in it.
